# crosswork_l3vpn_source_prefix_sets (Resource)

This resource can manage an L3VPN source prefix set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_l3vpn_source_prefix_sets" "example" {
  name = "cwtest-source-prefixes"
  mode = "ipv4"
  prefix_list = [
    {
      ip_prefix = "10.250.1.0/24"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the prefix set. Any ASCII character except `%`, `?` and `#`.

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.
- `mode` (String) Address family of the prefixes, which must all be of that family. NSO takes ipv4 when it is left out.
  - Choices: `ipv4`, `ipv6`
- `prefix_list` (Attributes Set) Prefixes of the set (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--prefix_list))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

<a id="nestedatt--prefix_list"></a>
### Nested Schema for `prefix_list`

Required:

- `ip_prefix` (String) IPv4 or IPv6 prefix with its length

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_l3vpn_source_prefix_sets.example "<name>"
```
